read.thesis: Record $7.8B backlog and Americas applied bookings up 120% (200% book-to-bill) support 2026 guide of 6-7% organic growth, though residential and transport remain weak and tariffs add about $50M.

capex.quote: we remain CapEx light in terms of intensity. You're right, Jeff, 1.5% to 2% has been the CapEx spend to revenues over the last few years.
